title: Couplings for Disposal of Sewage Water for Inland Vessels, Part 2: Quick-Release Couplings
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12115 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Couplings for Disposal of Sewage Water for Inland Vessels, Part 2: Quick-Release Couplings.
clause_3_terminology: Couplings for Disposal of Sewage Water for Inland Vessels

marking_requirements: 6.1 The couplings shall be marked with manufacturer's name or trade-mark and its designation.
6.1,1 Standard marking^ Details available with the
